answer: Score each agent with a passport of stamps from independent issuers: a verified operator domain, a paid cloud-billing account, a year-old code repo. Each issuer writes one nullifier per real-world holder into a shared vault, so a holder's stamp can back only one agent. Reward weight needs a threshold sum across distinct issuers, and a weekly beacon picks random stamps for re-verification. A clone farm's fable of many owners collapses once nullifiers collide.
